ball.q: Which Slovenian club beat Antonio Conte's Tottenham 2-1 in November 2021 with a winner in the 94th minute?
ball.sub: Amadej Maroša scored it. Spurs had beaten Mura 5-1 in London two months earlier.

ball.q: Tottenham were handed a 0-3 defeat by UEFA against Rennes in December 2021 after the game was called off. Why was it not played?
ball.a: A Covid outbreak in the Spurs squad
ball.sub: Rennes topped the group and Spurs finished third and went out.
